hold.description: Stay inside the assigned perimeter; use cover, dig, shift to a reachable firing point.

support.description: Advance cautiously to a supporting line; fire while the flanking squads move.

flank_left.description: Approach on the left, alternate covering and moving elements, then clear the objective.

flank_right.description: Approach on the right, alternate covering and moving elements, then clear the objective.

clear.description: Close on surviving contacts within the assigned defensive area.
